subject: [hw] DONE V14
body:
V14 (T32 16-bit instructions) done, host-tested only.

Last line of run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V14 PASS 386/386
Full command: bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v14/run_tests.sh
(Builds: clang -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all, then -O2 without sanitizers; encodings assembled by llvm-mc -triple=thumbv7a-linux-gnueabi -mattr=+neon,+vfp4,+hwdiv,+hwdiv-arm,+fp-armv8 and extracted with llvm-objdump; no hand-typed encodings. Sweep: all 65536 16-bit values + 200000 deterministic random words with all megabytes MMIO, under ASan/UBSan and -O2.)

Files: gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t16.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v14/{run_tests.sh,t16_enc.s,gen_enc.py,t16_tests.c,k14_t16.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V14/STATUS.md.

Implemented: every 16-bit T32 encoding except the deliberate list below, incl. the 16 data-processing ops, high-register ADD/CMP/MOV, ADD (SP plus register), BX/BLX, LDR literal, all load/store sizes and addressing variants, SP-relative, ADR, ADD/SUB SP, extend, CBZ/CBNZ, PUSH/POP, REV*, BKPT, IT, hints, B<c>, SVC, B, UDF, and LDM/STM (0xC000-0xCFFF, omitted from my deliverable text but unowned elsewhere). Flags per Arm ARM: CMP/CMN/TST always set flags (even in IT), high-register ADD/MOV never do, everything else setflags=!InITBlock(). SVC/BKPT/UDF set c->stop + stop_insn + stop_addr and return N2A32_UNDEF (V12 convention; asked hw-v02 to confirm the core preserves a non-NONE stop).

Deliberately N2A32_UNDEF (full table in STATUS.md): SETEND (0xB650/1), CPS (0xB660-0xB66F), HLT (0xBA80-0xBABF), reserved holes 0xB300-0xB3FF/0xB600-0xB6FF/0xB700-0xB8FF/0xBB00-0xBBFF, IT with firstcond 1111 or 1110 with popcount(mask)!=1 (architecturally UNPREDICTABLE; UNDEFINED permitted), and 32-bit prefixes / insn>0xFFFF (defensive). Architecturally UNPREDICTABLE encodings that are otherwise implemented execute deterministically (CMP/BX/BLX with PC, MOV/ADD PC in a non-last IT slot, IT in IT, LSL #0 in IT).

Not done / open:
1. Census acceptance not yet checkable: FACTS.md/census.py (hw-d01) not in the tree yet; I asked hw-d01 to flag any SETEND/CPS/HLT/reserved-hole use in the vendor libs. My implementation covers everything else, so I expect no gap.
2. Core stop convention + ITAdvance-after-IT: waiting for hw-v02; package follows the only written convention (V12 task text) and writes c->itstate=firstcond:mask.
3. BKPT inside IT always executes architecturally; if the core pre-skips on a failed IT condition that is a core-side behaviour I cannot see from the class (flagged to hw-v02).
4. Differential harness: kernel emu/test_v14/k14_t16.c (k14_alu/k14_mem/k14_branch) posted to hw-t01 for tests/emu (their dir, not mine); not yet run because emu/n2a32_core.c was not in the tree.

No phone access used, nothing published.
